evidence_gaps: Fresh runtime forensics within two hours.
Per-strategy and per-chain realised money-weighted NET P&L after all fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees and failed-attempt costs.
Immutable decision-time opportunity logs including abstentions, rejected signals and terminal reconciliation.
Explicit STRATEGY/MARKET versus EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure labels and counts.
Solana contemporaneous entry and exit quotes, liquidity, sellability, price impact, priority-fee and latency-reserve evidence.
EVM receipt-confirmed outcomes without expected-P&L substitution, including reverted, timed-out and unreconciled broadcasts.
Chronological out-of-sample results by chain, strategy, route and notional.
Drawdown, tail-loss, profit-factor confidence intervals and execution-failure cost rates.
Evidence that forecast probabilities and expected-net estimates are calibrated without look-ahead leakage.
Sufficient independent wallets, routes and market regimes to rule out concentration-driven results.

proposals.downside_risk: More strategies will remain unclassified or in SHADOW until complete receipts and cost attribution are available.

evidence.detail: _record_market_native_progress accepts SUCCESS, SUCCESS_FEE_PENDING and BROADCAST, falls back from realised_net_base to expected_net_base, and ignores rejected attempts.
Windows contain execution_failures, fees and slippage fields, but promotion decisions use aggregate net and profit factor without failure-rate or attribution requirements.
Execution records expose realised P&L, actual gas, profit fee, status and rejection reason, providing inputs for stricter attribution.

proposals.expected_effect: Unbiased net-P&L scorecards and explicit diagnosis of bad signals versus quote, RPC, inclusion, receipt or reconciliation failures.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 100 eligible opportunities, 30 terminal simulated or realised attempts, three independent market regimes, and at least five observed failures per chain where failures occur.
proposals.rationale: Expected P&L is not realised money-weighted evidence, BROADCAST is not confirmed success, and omitted failed attempts can bias strategy evaluation upward. Record confirmed realised net after every applicable cost and classify each non-success as STRATEGY_MARKET, EXECUTION_INFRASTRUCTURE or SAFETY_ABSTENTION.
proposals.shadow_test: Replay at least 100 chronological opportunities per chain from immutable decision-time inputs. Reconcile every attempt to a terminal outcome and all fees, slippage, price impact, gas or priority fees. Fail if any BROADCAST or expected-only result counts as realised P&L, terminal coverage is below 99%, cost reconciliation differs from wallet deltas beyond documented rounding, or failure class is missing.

proposals.downside_risk: Additional quote traffic and selection bias if quotes are captured only for attractive signals; sampling must include abstentions and failures.

evidence.detail: Solana observations deliberately set gross edge, fees, slippage, price impact, liquidity and sellability to zero and mark outcome_available false.
Every strategy requires positive current net edge plus liquidity, sellability and quote freshness, so current Solana inputs correctly fail closed.

proposals.expected_effect: Allows falsifiable Solana SHADOW evaluation without inventing edge or weakening existing safety gates.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 500 chronologically sampled opportunities, 100 executable round-trip simulations, 30 days, multiple volatility and congestion regimes, and separate results by notional and route.
proposals.rationale: Leader history or win ratio cannot demonstrate current executable edge. Solana needs decision-time round-trip quote, sellability and cost evidence including priority fees, account rent where applicable, price impact, latency reserve and failed-attempt cost.
proposals.shadow_test: For every sampled signal, timestamp immutable entry and exit quotes at the intended notional, include all Solana-specific costs and model latency decay, then compare predicted net edge with executable future round-trip outcomes. Stop if quote coverage is below 95%, sellability cannot be verified, more than 1% of records omit a cost component, or lower-bound net edge is non-positive.

proposals.downside_risk: Candidate count and apparent historical performance will decline.

evidence.detail: avg_net_base is calculated only from positive proven outcomes, excluding proven losses from the learned average.
The stored average base-token result is converted to basis points using the current notional, which may differ from historical notionals.
Eligibility requires learned_route_avg_net_bps above zero, so positively selected history can influence admission.

proposals.expected_effect: Route replication will rank routes by full-distribution, notional-normalised net outcomes and avoid promotion driven by discarded losses.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 50 proven terminal outcomes per route family, 20 out-of-sample outcomes, five independent wallets or economically independent sources, and coverage across at least three windows.
proposals.rationale: A positive-only historical mean creates survivorship bias, and rescaling absolute historical profit by current notional does not produce a valid historical return estimate.
proposals.shadow_test: Recompute route statistics from all proven terminal outcomes using per-trade net bps after costs, with chronological train/test splits and wallet-cluster separation. Fail if out-of-sample money-weighted net is non-positive, profit factor is at most 1, the lower confidence bound is non-positive, or results depend on one wallet or route cluster.

proposals.downside_risk: Longer research cycles and fewer promotion candidates.

evidence.detail: Research promotion can occur after three windows, eight trades, positive net and profit factor of 1.10 without an explicit chain-specific out-of-sample, drawdown or failure-rate threshold.
The scorecard correctly states that quote simulations are not promotion evidence.

proposals.expected_effect: Reduces false promotion caused by small samples, regime luck or stronger-chain results masking weaker-chain losses.
proposals.minimum_observation: At least 30 days, 100 terminal outcomes per promoted chain, five independent windows, and a reserved chronological holdout containing at least 30 outcomes; otherwise report INSUFFICIENT DATA.
proposals.rationale: Eight trades cannot establish durable money-weighted edge, and pooled results can hide materially different Solana and EVM economics.
proposals.shadow_test: Evaluate each strategy separately by chain, route, notional bucket and chronological holdout. Include all costs and failed attempts. Stop or rework when holdout net is non-positive, profit factor is at most 1, drawdown exceeds the predefined budget, execution-failure cost erases edge, or performance is concentrated in one short regime.

rejected_ideas.idea: Promote any strategy from the current review.
rejected_ideas.reason: Runtime forensics are missing and the evidence explicitly prohibits profitability, CANARY and LIVE-readiness claims.

rejected_ideas.idea: Force trades to increase sample size or win count.
rejected_ideas.reason: This violates the positive executable-edge objective and would confound abstention quality with strategy performance.

rejected_ideas.idea: Use Solana leader win ratio as current edge.
rejected_ideas.reason: Historical win frequency omits current quotes, exit sellability, costs, sizing and money-weighted loss magnitude.

rejected_ideas.idea: Pool Solana and EVM results into one promotion statistic.
rejected_ideas.reason: Their fee, inclusion, latency, liquidity and failure economics are materially different.

summary: Architecture-only review completed. The repository generally enforces abstention and cost-adjusted executable edge, but current evidence cannot establish profitability or CANARY/LIVE readiness. Solana deliberately lacks a current executable-edge adapter. EVM shadow outcomes are simulations, while LIVE aggregation can substitute expected P&L for missing realised P&L and excludes rejected execution attempts, preventing reliable separation of STRATEGY/MARKET loss from EXECUTION/INFRASTRUCTURE failure.
